title: Feature-Positive Effect
coreMove: Name the feature-positive effect in the room, then redesign the next choice so it cannot choose for you.
sourcePressure: The frozen TOC and official source notes frame Feature-Positive Effect as a specific decision error around feature-positive, absent evidence, visible cues. Traceable support includes Regula- tory Focus, Feature Positive Effect, and Message Framing.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Feature-Positive Effect as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: name the feature-positive effect in the room, then redesign the next choice so it cannot choose for you.
